d:
The Heat defeated the Clippers, 117-116 tonight in LA. Bam Adebayo finished with a team-high 35 points along with 10 rebounds and 4 assists for the Heat, while Klay Thompson tallied 30 points, 8 three pointers and 5 rebounds in the game. Darius Garland recorded 26 points, 7 assists and 4 three pointers. The Heat improve their record to 3-5 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 1-7 for the season.
